original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚因刚果（金）埃博拉疫情高度戒备，边境担忧加剧
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚因刚果（金）埃博拉疫情而处于高度戒备状态，并已确认第二例相关病例。据报该病毒在肯尼亚已致一人死亡，共记录两例病例。在乌干达边境，筛查力度加强，旅客接受体温检测和洗手措施。

location.site: 乌干达边境（布西亚口岸）
location.raw_text: Kenya's border with Uganda, Busia crossing

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚因刚果（金）埃博拉疫情处于高度戒备状态
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya on high alert as Ebola outbreak in DR Congo fuels border fears

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚已确认第二例与刚果（金）疫情相关的埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: after the country confirmed its second case linked to an outbreak in Congo

key_facts.fact: 在乌干达边境布西亚口岸，旅客接受体温检测和洗手措施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Travelers washed their hands and had their temperatures checked at Kenya’s border with Uganda on Thursday

key_facts.fact: 据报该病毒在肯尼亚已致一人死亡，共记录两例病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the virus has reportedly claimed one life in Kenya, with two cases recorded

uncertainties: 埃博拉在肯尼亚的死亡和病例数仅为据报，尚未获独立确认
